scope: Numbered scripts tracked by Git at code/<n>_<name>.py and code/archive/<n>_<name>.py; references measured over every Git-tracked text file except the catalogues that name every script.

reference_kinds.script: named by another file under code/ (import, loader, subprocess or prose)
reference_kinds.product_code: named under server/, scripts/, src/ or tests/
reference_kinds.documented: named in a tracked document (docs/, README.md, START_HERE.md, review/)
reference_kinds.journal: named only in AGENTS.md, the append-only journal
reference_kinds.data_or_config: named in a tracked data, configuration or registry file
reference_kinds.stem_only: named by its number-free stem (the _script(number, stem) loader shape)
reference_kinds.number_keyed: named by number in a loader or documentary form (code/<n>, "<n>")

archive_rule: zero references of any kind, no tracked artifact written, census status not ACTIVE, not on NEVER_RUN, in no table contract or ordering; moved to code/archive/, never deleted

untracked_writes: state a tier on the ruling row, or re-apply it through agent_identifier_rulings_applied.csv
modal county of this row's own city+state in geo_place_county_crosswalk.csv
